partner_result_applied.name: QFORM-SEPARATED-SYMMETRIC-UNIMODAL-OFFZERO-v1
partner_result_applied.actual_use: Normalize the truncated sigma-finite singleton cap majorant to Unif[-R,R]; partner theorem gives bar_p_R(t)<=bar_p_R(0), then monotone convergence gives the global output reduction for the arbitrary cap-one singleton.

external_premise.source: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, arXiv:1507.07949
external_premise.scope: For a product probability density with each one-dimensional factor <=1, every one-dimensional marginal density is <=sqrt(2). Applied once to each bank and once to the doubled difference bank to obtain L-infinity and L2 bounds.

main_result: For A=diag(alpha,beta aa^T,-gamma bb^T), ||a||=||b||=1, alpha,beta,gamma>=1, arbitrary cap-one singleton law, and arbitrary independent even-unimodal cap-one physical laws in the two distinct banks, the quadratic-form density is globally bounded by C_sep=4[pi/(6sqrt2)+(1/2)int_{pi/6}^{pi/2}(sin theta)^(-1/2)dtheta]=3.8172923460947289...<3sqrt2.
not_used: No arbitrary-joint rank-three coarea bound, conditional projection-cap moment, post-rotation independence, physical rank-three cross extraction, scalar-remainder worst conditioning, universal finite-fragment reduction, or law-uniform pointwise oscillatory decay.
unresolved_implication: The theorem does not cover shared-coordinate/non-collinear heavy rows, asymmetric/fragmented laws inside the aggregate banks, coupled non-rank-one spectral tails, or the unrestricted arbitrary A target.
next_step: Attack a genuinely shared-coordinate three-heavy configuration in which at least one physical coordinate contributes to two spectral directions, while keeping an integrated positive-kernel or sigma-finite-majorant inequality that survives arbitrary cap-one singleton fragmentation.
